method: After freezing the pair, returned to the cohort 2026 curriculum table, Appendix 3 entry requirements, official major page and optional profile. Reconstructed the common, track and choice credits and traced the thresholds and participation conditions to the thesis. Re-read workbook topics and methods for the three replacements, the available term cells and the revised alignment and content. findings: Utrecht’s 2026–27 English-taught Global Sustainability Science BSc has a 135 EC major and 45 EC optional profile. The major is 60 EC common requirements plus 75 EC of track requirements and major choices. The first-listed track is Water, Climate & Ecosystems. Chemistry and the Environment, Global Climate Change, Ecological Field Research, Ecohydrology and a 15 EC thesis contribute 45 EC. Philosophy of Science and Ethics, ordinary Consultancy Project and the two advanced choices Landscape Ecology and Nature Conservation and Environmental Chemistry and Health contribute 30 EC. Appendix 2 lists those choices separately from the already-required Ecohydrology. The 45 EC profile requires at least 15 EC at levels 2–3. The case records a curriculum structure, without asserting a registered Utrecht timeslot plan.

The core has 45 EC at introductory level and 15 EC at intermediate level. Research Skills runs with the Regional Integration Project, and full participation in Research Skills precedes Statistics. Passing Research Skills and the Regional Integration Project and full participation in Statistics precede Global Transformation. Ecohydrology requires 90 EC and assumes the three earlier track courses. Consultancy requires 90 EC including Sustainability Challenges and both integration projects. For the thesis, pass seven listed common courses, the three level 1–2 track courses and at least one advanced major elective. Active participation in Statistics, consultancy and Ecohydrology is also required.

The two 7.5 EC advanced choices are distinct from the required 7.5 EC Ecohydrology. The UCR science plan uses real soil and aquifer fieldwork and an ecology extension, the governance plan uses a civil-society research project, and the business plan uses market research. Each fits the relevant progression and four-course load. Utrecht’s 15 EC thesis is a required separate component. UCR optional independent research remains additional.
